description: Bookstore product page on the same template as book-pdp-jsonld but with no structured data: everything comes from the DOM, including a product information table and a rating encoded only as a CSS class.

availability.description: Stock status without the count, e.g. 'In stock'

notes: No JSON-LD, so this exercises the DOM/LLM path. Rating 3 exists only as class 'star-rating Three'. stock_count 22 comes from 'In stock (22 available)'; availability is the status without the count. reviews is 0 (a present, falsy value: must not be reported as missing). The 'recently viewed' strip (Tipping the Velvet £53.74, The Black Maria £52.15, Shakespeare's Sonnets £20.66) and the window.__BASKET__ upsell are decoys.
